thread:
jake: quick heads-up — bringing up northstar-v1 embeddings for semantic search. baseline fp32 looks good but int8 per-tensor is showing a head-only drop on short queries (qlen<=4). can someone take a look? dashboard: https://internal-evals/northstar-v1

rachel: can you paste the numbers and quant config?

jake: pasted below. quant: ONNX static per-tensor int8, calibrate on 5k heldout.
```
model               r@1    r@10   r@50   mean_cosine
northstar-v1-fp32   0.398  0.655  0.801  0.224
northstar-v1-int8   0.392  0.627  0.752  0.168
```

tom: ~5% drop at r@50, and mean cosine drops a lot. sounds like directional collapse. did you check vector norms / cosine histograms? :bar_chart:

jake: yes — mean L2 norm down ~9% after quant, cosine histogram shifts left. UMAP shows tail clusters pulled inward. attaching quick images to dashboard.

priya: any recent pooling or head changes in the checkpoint? northstar had a tiny pooling tweak last cycle. short queries depend more on head behavior.

jake: onboarding used mean-pooling. I'll re-run with cls-pool.

bench-bot: started job nb-901 for northstar-v1-pooler-compare (ETA ~10m)

leo: If pooling swap doesn't help, try per-channel quantization or using symmetric quant + zero-point removal. per-channel usually preserves directional info in projection layers.

jake: good plan. also thinking about a cheap post-quant affine rescale per-dim to match fp32 means before unit-norm. micro-calib on heldout: compute s,b so E[s*x+b]=E[x_fp32].

rachel: small script idea: compute per-dim mean ratios and apply clip at 1.2 to avoid blowing up noise. could be quick to test.

priya: also check tokenization edgecases — short queries often are 1-2 tokens and may be sensitive to special token embeddings. any tokenizer mismatches?
jake: tokenizer identical. confirmed no special handling changes.

leo: another simpler test: do cosine-normalize after applying a global scale (match mean norm). sometimes preserving norm distribution reduces recall loss.

infra-bot: provisioning: +3 gpus to eng-ml-staging for nb-902 (per-channel + affine)

jake: spinning per-channel-int8 + affine-calib job now (nb-902). will post r@50 stratified by qlen when done.

bench-bot: nb-902 running. expected ~20m.

tom: if per-channel + affine recovers >2% r@50 on qlen<=4 we can do a canary rollout on search. else fallback to fp32 for small queries via routing rule.

rachel: also add a quick silhouette/cluster-compactness metric to the eval to track cluster contraction automatically.

jake: noted — adding silhouette and centroid-delta to dashboard and saving UMAP snapshots. i'll open a tiny PR with the norm-check + affine scripts in eng-ml/utils. will wait for nb-902 results and report back. :thumbsup:
